panel.rule: Every formula starts with an equals sign =

say: Here is a worked example. Ngozi runs a small provisions shop in Enugu and wants to stop adding up sales on a calculator at night.
She sells 2 cartons of noodles at 9500, so equals C2 star D2 gives 19000.
3 bottles of groundnut oil at 3200 give 9600. 6 bars of soap at 700 give 4200.
In E5 she adds them up. The day's total is 32800 naira.
Later she corrects the soap price to 750. E4 becomes 4500 and the total 33100, without her doing anything else.
A spreadsheet can only calculate what it understands. Type 5000 as a plain number, then let formatting add the naira sign and the commas.
Keep one row for each sale or expense, one column for each detail, and headings in row 1 only.

panel.heading: Type numbers the spreadsheet understands
left: Headings in row 1, no blank rows

say: This is the common mistake. If you type N5000 or 5k, the sheet sees words, not a number, and your totals will quietly be wrong.
Quick check. Numbers sit on the right of the cell, text on the left. If an amount sits on the left, retype it.

say: Now, functions. These are ready-made calculations with names. Bisi sells rice and stew in Ibadan, and types her daily takings for 6 days in cells B2 to B7.

card.title: Bisi's week of sales
card.note: AVERAGE counts zeros but ignores empty cells.

say: SUM adds the whole range. Her week comes to 97000 naira.

card.title: Bisi's week of sales
card.note: AVERAGE counts zeros but ignores empty cells.

say: MIN finds her worst day, 8000 on Tuesday. MAX finds her best day, 30500 on Saturday.
AVERAGE counts zeros but ignores empty cells. So she leaves Sunday blank, when she is closed, and her average reflects trading days only.

say: Your records are money, so protect them. Save online. A phone that is stolen or dropped in water should not take your records with it.

cards.d: Google Sheets saves to Google Drive. In Excel, save to OneDrive with AutoSave on.
Go back to yesterday's copy if something is deleted. Download a backup once a month.
Never Enable Macros in a file from a stranger. Real bank alerts come by SMS or your app.

say: Use version history to go back to an earlier copy, and download a backup once a month.

say: And never open spreadsheet attachments from strangers that ask you to Enable Macros to see an invoice or payment alert. That is a common way to install harmful software.

say: To remember. Cells are named column letter, then row number. Type facts once and let formulas do the maths.
Type plain numbers, with no N and no k. Use SUM, AVERAGE, MIN and MAX. And keep your file saved online and safe from scams.

panel.heading: Remember
items: Cells are named column letter, then row number
Type raw facts once; formulas like =C2*D2 do the maths
Plain numbers only: no N, no k
SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX answer everyday questions
Save online and never enable macros from strangers
